[[File:Amanita_Lumikurzini.png|thumb|right|150px|Amanita Lumikurnizi]]
'''Amanita Lumikurnizi''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of rare plant found in caverns within the jungles of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. The plant's spores produced a biochemical compound of hybrid [[psilocybin]] that acted as a powerful mental and physical stimulant to most organics, though it was highly toxic in large doses.
